turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Doctor, I’m 67, and I’ve been in home hospice. Lately my mind has been getting confused and I can’t communicate clearly, and I’ve also had an elevated temperature and discomfort in my right upper abdomen.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you often find yourself needing to rush to the bathroom to urinate, or feeling like you can't hold your urine for a short period of time?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I don’t really remember needing to rush to the bathroom or having accidents—I’ve been too confused lately to say for sure, and I can’t hold details consistently.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a firm lump or mass in your breast that you can feel when you touch it?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I’m not able to check or reliably describe any breast lump or mass right now because my thinking has been confused. I can only tell you that lately I’ve had a higher temperature and discomfort in my right upper abdomen, and my communication has been getting worse.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any small, raised bumps on your skin that feel firm to the touch?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I don’t think I can reliably tell you about any small raised bumps on my skin or whether they feel firm, because my confusion has been making it hard to notice and describe things consistently.”

turns.doctor_question: How have you been feeling in terms of temperature regulation lately? Have you noticed that you're having trouble cooling down, even when you're in a cool environment or not physically active?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I’ve had an elevated temperature and I don’t seem to cool down well, even when I’m in a cool room and not moving much. I’ve also felt uncomfortable in my right upper abdomen, and my confusion has been getting worse.”

turns.doctor_question: How have you been feeling lately? Have you been experiencing a lot of stress or feeling overwhelmed?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I’ve been feeling more confused and uncomfortable lately, but I don’t really know about stress or feeling overwhelmed—I’m mostly focused on not feeling right and my thinking has been getting worse.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itching or a sensation that makes you want to scratch, either on specific areas of your body or all over?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I don’t think I’ve noticed any itching or a strong urge to scratch, but with how confused I’ve been, I can’t say for sure. I mainly just feel feverish, uncomfortable in my right upper abdomen, and more disoriented than before.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any unusual spots, rashes, or lesions along the veins on your arms?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I don’t think I’ve noticed any unusual spots, rashes, or lesions along the veins on my arms, but with my confusion I may not be able to tell reliably.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that it's been harder to find the right words when you're talking to people lately? Sometimes, do you struggle to get a specific word out, like it's on the tip of your tongue?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, yes—lately it’s been hard to find the right words, and I feel disoriented like my thoughts don’t come out clearly. I’m not able to describe it well, but my communication has been getting worse along with the feverish feeling and right upper abdominal discomfort.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any stiffness or inflexibility in your muscles, like it's hard to move your arms or legs, or do your muscles feel unusually tense?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I don’t think my muscles have been unusually stiff or tense, and I haven’t noticed it being hard to move my arms or legs—mostly I just feel feverish, uncomfortable in my right upper abdomen, and increasingly disoriented.”

turns.doctor_question: How would you describe your level of alertness right now? Do you feel unusually sleepy or drowsy?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I feel more drowsy and less alert than usual, and my attention won’t stay focused. I’m also more disoriented than before, and it’s hard for me to think clearly.”

turns.doctor_question: How are your legs feeling in terms of temperature? Do they feel warm to you, or do they feel cooler than the rest of your body?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t really been able to tell how warm or cool my legs are compared to the rest of my body—I’m feeling generally feverish, more drowsy, and disoriented, and I can’t focus on those details right now.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you find that you're coughing up mucus or phlegm when you cough?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I’m not really sure—I haven’t been able to pay close attention to coughing or phlegm because my main issues are the feverish feeling, worsening disorientation, and discomfort in my right upper abdomen.”
